problem: A marketplace listing marked Free does not by itself bind the applicable license, acquisition receipt, source-format rights, AI-use boundary or redistribution mode. Method study, project incorporation and standalone redistribution are different claims.

externalEvidence.sourceProvenance: Official Fab EULA summary and Epic Fab documentation, read 2026-11-11.
facts: Fab offers CC-BY and Standard licenses; Standard products can be free or paid, so price is not license identity.
Fab Standard permits modification, use with compatible tools and distribution of Projects with assets incorporated.
Fab Standard prohibits free or paid standalone redistribution of the asset.
Reference-Only grants referenced access rather than source format.
CC-BY follows its own attribution terms.
Legacy UE Marketplace terms may still apply and must be read from the listing/acquisition record.
Downloading a free Standard product requires accepting the applicable EULA.

currentBestView.covered: R2 and the reference gate require truthful provenance and source-to-change mapping; N263/N265 detect missing or dangling source/license pointers.
currentBestView.gap: No applicable regression was found that distinguishes Free price from exact license identity, method-only observation from content incorporation, or project incorporation from standalone asset redistribution.

boundedQuestion: What minimum receipt allows a Fab item to be studied as a method, incorporated into a KAOPU WebGPU project, or rejected from public redistribution without treating Free price as permission?
falsifiableHypothesis: Binding exact listing and publisher identity, exact license type/tier/terms, EULA acquisition, intended AI use, project-incorporation boundary, public source exposure and attribution will allow method-only study and rights-bound project use while rejecting unbound, Reference-Only source conversion, NoAI training, missing CC-BY attribution and standalone redistribution.

activation.rollbackPoint: Remove this Candidate if a real acquisition and publication trial shows no discrimination beyond an existing rights receipt; do not modify R2 or production gates before that trial.

limits: This is an operational evidence gate, not legal advice or a final legal determination.
The listing pages' blank crawled License terms field does not prove that no license exists; it proves only that this run did not bind the exact listing license.
A Project-use pass does not prove visual fidelity, runtime quality, browser/device success or user acceptance.
NoAI inference use remains HOLD when asset media would be supplied to a generative model and the exact permitted scope is not independently resolved.
